item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":4,"rationale":"The President immediately prohibits specified Rhodesia-related conduct, creating present legal duties, while the same segment also delegates enforcement functions and directs later agency action; these materially different postures are inseparably combined in the supplied segment.","evidence":"the following are prohibited effective immediately"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The Treasury, Commerce, and Transportation Secretaries must consult the Secretary of State while performing their assigned functions; this is an internal coordination requirement without an independently specified legal consequence.","evidence":"shall consult with the Secretary of State"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The relevant Secretary is directed, when appropriate, to consult agencies and private persons; this governs administrative coordination rather than dictating a legal outcome.","evidence":"Secretary shall consult, as appropriate, with other government agencies and private persons."},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretaries receive discretion to issue implementing instruments as they consider necessary, while the definitions and continuation of the earlier order support administration of the sanctions regime without themselves specifying a new substantive outcome in this segment.","evidence":"Each such Secretary shall issue such regulations, licenses or other authorizations as he considers necessary"}]}
